high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A singular, prominent dark circular spot is located in the anterior dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single circular, shadow-casting depression is visible along the anterior midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-contrast white flecks/spots are distributed across the visible dorsal plane.
